agent-task list.--web: Opens the cloud agent-task page in a browser instead of issuing a forge API request; ctx.gh has no interactive browser. Non-browser GHES refusal is tested.

agent-task view.--web: Opens an agent-task page in a browser; no cloud session or browser is provisioned. Non-browser session/PR selectors and log/follow refusals are tested.

codespace code.--web: Launches the browser-based VS Code client for a cloud codespace. GHES cannot supply a running codespace or browser; normal and insiders modes test the auth guard.

codespace create.--web: Delegates creation to a browser and is incompatible with display-name/idle-timeout/retention-period. No browser or cloud workspace may be provisioned by this sweep.

codespace list.--web: Opens github.com/codespaces in a browser rather than listing via the GHES API, and cannot combine with org/user selection. Normal output modes and live GHES HTTP errors are tested.

extension search.--web: Opens search results in a browser instead of returning searchable API output. The harness deliberately disables browser launches; all non-browser search output and filter flags are exercised.
